identification: French brass carriage clock, timepiece only (8 day), 'colonne'/column case with four fluted columns topped by turned finials, leaf-moulded friezes top and bottom, turned bun feet, fluted carry handle, bevelled top glass, white enamel chapter ring with Arabic numerals around an engine-turned gilt centre, spade hands. Back plate shows only the winding arbor, hand-set square and ratchet click; no strike train, no repeat button, no alarm. Probably c.1900-1920. Lot page estimate A$150-250.

viewing_check: Wind and check it runs for several minutes; look under the base and on the back plate for any stamp (maker, serial, 'Made in France', medallion); check enamel dial for hairlines and chips; check platform escapement through top glass is ticking; any key or case.
